pages.raw_title: Meridian Holdings | Global Gaming & Betting Company
pages.raw_meta: Meridian Holdings is a leading global gaming and betting company operating across multiple markets with innovative digital solutions and strong industry presence.
raw_blocks: A global iGaming powerhouse operating the full stack of the gaming business: sportsbook, online casino, raffles and competitions in more than 25 countries.

All our brands, Meridianbet, Expanse Studios, R Kings Competitions, Classics For A Cause, GM-AG, and MexPlay are supported by a scalable proprietary tech platform tailored for every regulated market worldwide. From B2C to B2B and from street-level retail shops to premium online offers, it is all under one roof.
With an international team of over 1,400 experts, we own and operate each brand in our portfolio, enabling us to offer consumers and businesses the very best of each gaming segment.
Our strength is our human capital. With a global workforce of more than 1,400 professionals and over 120 in-house software developers. We build, maintain, and scale our own technology in real-time.

We operate a complete iGaming ecosystem across B2B and B2C sectors. Every second, our proprietary products are live on 30+ worldwide web destinations and throughout our 735+ bricks-and-mortar locations.
Our business model is powered by scalable, proprietary technology tailored for 25+ regulated markets. By owning our full tech stack, we eliminate third-party fees and maximize operational margins.
Powered by people. Trusted by players. Built for the future of iGaming.

pages.raw_title: Meridian Holdings | Global iGaming & Technology Company
pages.raw_meta: Meridian Holdings is a global iGaming and technology company operating across 25+ markets with proprietary platforms, in-house expertise and a portfolio of leading gaming brands.
raw_blocks: Founded in 2001 and listed on NASDAQ (MRDN) in 2024, Meridian Holdings is a globally recognized technology and iGaming solutions provider. Built on a foundation of proprietary technology and strategic acquisitions, the company operates the full stack of the gaming business, spanning sportsbook, online casino, raffles and competitions across more than 25 international markets.

With an international team of over 1,400 professionals, Meridian Holdings combines deep operational expertise with in-house technology, allowing the group to control its platforms, optimize margins and continuously develop new products for both B2C and B2B partners.

Today, we are present on all continents, and our portfolio includes a number of global brands: Meridianbet, Expanse Studios, R Kings Competitions, Classics For A Cause, GM-AG and MexPlay—all powered by a scalable proprietary platform designed to adapt to the regulatory, operational and consumer requirements of diverse markets worldwide.

From street-level retail betting shops to premium online gaming experiences, Meridian Holdings brings every element of the gaming ecosystem under one roof, positioning the company as a vertically integrated iGaming powerhouse delivering technology, content and operations at global scale.
Australia’s Leading Loyalty Subscription Provider
The UK’s Leading Digital Raffle Platform
Asia’s Leading Partner for iGaming Distribution
Mexico’s Leading Destination for Online Play
